name: Destroy the Dracolich
description: Find the Arcane Circle and defeat the Dracolich Varkath. Destroy Varkath's Phylactery in the Laboratory to deal massive damage to him.

specialRules.description: When the Arcane Circle is revealed, do not draw a Monster card. Spawn Varkath on it. Automatically place the Laboratory tile at least 4 tiles away and spawn Varkath's Phylactery on it.
A Hero adjacent to the Laboratory tile can make an attack against the Phylactery. Destroying the Phylactery immediately deals 10 damage to Varkath.

introText: Lord Karl Von Nekrula has raised the dracolich Varkath to guard his crypts. You must find the Arcane Circle to challenge Varkath, and search out his phylactery in the Laboratory to weaken him.
victoryText: Varkath explodes into shards of bone and green fire! The dracolich is defeated, and Nekrula's most powerful ally is no more.
defeatText: Varkath's lightning breath consumes you. Your bones will join his hoard in the crypts of The Shadowhold.
